checks.method: Static trace of synthesized Codable model declarations
checks.result: Position x/y/z; LightingScene schemaVersion/subject/camera/lights; StudioLight id/name/position/candela/kelvin; LightOptics kind/widthMeters/heightMeters; ManualRoom widthMeters/depthMeters/subjectX/subjectZ/yawDegrees are nonoptional. Ordinary initializer defaults do not make these decoded required members optional. Nested present objects with missing nonoptional members fail decoding; no generated IDs or substituted required values were found.

checks.method: Static trace of Scene.swift validated() and optional member declarations
checks.result: Absent/null optics, cameraLens, previewSettings, placementRoom, aimTarget, rollDegrees, and ceilingHeightMeters represent intentional model defaults. Validation rejects optics in v1, a lens before v3, preview settings before v4, and measured-room/roll values before v5. Successful v1-v4 scenes migrate only their schema version to v5.

checks.method: Static trace of LightingProjectDocument.init and LightingScene.validated()
checks.result: Document construction validates scene values. Model requires at most 12 lights, unique decoded UUIDs, finite bounded coordinates, valid names and finite bounded light/color/optics/room values. No recognized-value truncation, light filtering, UUID regeneration, or coercive replacement was found in the import path. Lens and preview validity are delegated by LightingScene; their type definitions were not further reviewed.

checks.check: Nested duplicate policy and test coverage
checks.method: Review of duplicate-policy invocation and six NestedIntegrity test methods; lexical implementation excluded
checks.result: Project decoding calls requireUniqueObjectKeys after model decoding. Tests assert rejection of duplicate scene/light/position/optics/lens/preview fields and escaped-equivalent names, including duplicate members inside ignored metadata; sibling reuse remains accepted. Tests also specify acceptance of unique unknown metadata and Unicode-distinct names. No execution was performed.

checks.method: Static review of encoder/model property symmetry and canonical round-trip assertions
checks.result: Envelope encoding writes LightingScene through Codable, retaining its recognized optional settings and light identities. No valid current-encoder document losing recognized scene/room/light values was identified. Existing nested tests assert canonical scene round trip for multiple named rectangular lights, but this worker did not run those tests.

checks.method: Compare outer-envelope closure with nested Codable behavior and metadata acceptance tests
checks.result: Outer closure is explicitly scoped to the envelope. Nested synthesized Codable accepts unique unknown names. Tests deliberately accept/discard nested metadata. No inspected contract requires rejecting all unknown nested structural names; permissiveness alone is therefore not classified as a defect.

observations.case: In an otherwise valid schema-v5 scene, renaming light optics to optic, placementRoom to placementRooms, or ceilingHeightMeters to ceilingHeightMeter leaves the recognized optional member absent. Synthesized decoding ignores the unknown member, giving the documented nil/default semantics.
observations.assessment: Source-derived behavior, not a runtime reproduction. This does not demonstrate loss of recognized fields emitted by the current encoder. The repository explicitly tests unknown-metadata compatibility and no inspected specification requires a closed nested schema. An initial P1 hypothesis was withdrawn after coordinator challenge.
observations.possible_followup: If future product requirements demand typo rejection for editable external files, define an explicit nested schema/extension policy and add tests before tightening import; avoid accidentally changing legacy SceneCodec compatibility.
